artifact.label: Artifact
artifact.definition: An item that works automatically when its condition is met. It does not cost Energy to activate.

hp.label: HP
hp.definition: Your current health. At 0 HP, Alyssa is defeated.

max_hp.label: Max HP
max_hp.definition: The most HP Alyssa can have. Healing stops at this value.

heal.label: Heal
heal.definition: Restore missing HP, up to Max HP. The result shows the HP actually restored.

damage.label: Damage
damage.definition: Attack damage is reduced by the relevant defenses and Block before any remaining damage reduces HP.

block.label: Block
block.definition: Temporary protection that absorbs incoming damage. Its reset follows the core combat rules.

strength.label: Strength
strength.definition: Increases damage from Attack cards. The exact card calculation follows the core combat rules.

agility.label: Agility
agility.definition: Increases the Block gained from Defend cards. The exact card calculation follows the core combat rules.

energy.label: Energy
energy.definition: Points used to pay the Energy cost of playing cards.

focus.label: Focus
focus.definition: Definition pending: this pack gives +1 Focus and refers to an existing cap, but does not define the ability or cap value.

attack.label: Attack
attack.definition: A card type used to attack enemies.

defend.label: Defend
defend.definition: A card type used to gain Block.

skill.label: Skill
skill.definition: A card type with a special effect, such as drawing or replacing cards. Read its description for the exact effect.

passive.label: Passive
passive.definition: A card type that gives buffs or ongoing effects as described on the card. It must still be played at its stated cost.

draw.label: Draw
draw.definition: Move cards from the Draw Pile into your Hand. The actual number follows the hand limit and available cards.

hand.label: Hand
hand.definition: The cards currently held for you to play.

draw_pile.label: Draw Pile
draw_pile.definition: The pile from which you draw cards. Reshuffling follows the core game rules.

discard.label: Discard
discard.definition: The pile for played or discarded cards. These cards can re-enter the draw cycle under the core game rules.

exhaust.label: Exhaust
exhaust.definition: A separate pile for cards removed from the normal Draw and Discard cycle during this combat.

gold.label: Gold
gold.definition: Money used for purchases in the Shop.

shop.label: Shop
shop.definition: A dungeon location where you can buy the available goods with Gold.

discount.label: Discount
discount.definition: A reduction in a purchase price. The final price uses the highest applicable artifact discount and rounds up to a whole Gold.

turn.label: Turn
turn.definition: One period in which the player or enemies act.

combat.label: Combat
combat.definition: One battle, from its start until victory or defeat.

run.label: Run
run.definition: One dungeon attempt, from its start until victory or defeat.

first_turn.label: First turn
first_turn.definition: Only Alyssa’s opening turn in each combat.

combat_start.label: Start of combat
combat_start.definition: When a new battle begins, before the opening turn actions.

start_turn.label: Start of each turn
start_turn.definition: The beginning of each player turn. Apply core resets before the relevant artifact additions.

once_turn.label: Once per turn
once_turn.definition: This effect can activate only once in the stated turn, then becomes available for the next turn.

once_combat.label: Once per combat
once_combat.definition: This effect can activate only once in this battle. A new battle resets it.

acquisition.label: When obtained
acquisition.definition: Apply the effect once when this artifact is acquired in the run. Viewing the item again does not repeat it.

end_turn.label: End Turn
end_turn.definition: Finish the player’s turn. Unspent Energy checks happen before unused Energy is cleared.

played_card.label: Played card
played_card.definition: A card successfully resolved from your Hand. Drawing, previewing, canceled cards and artifact retaliation do not count.

first_attack.label: First Attack each turn
first_attack.definition: Only the first eligible Attack card in this player turn receives this artifact bonus.

first_defend.label: First Defend each turn
first_defend.definition: Only the first eligible Defend card in this player turn receives this artifact bonus.

first_skill_combat.label: First Skill each combat
first_skill_combat.definition: Only the first successfully resolved Skill card in this combat triggers this effect.

first_skill_turn.label: First Skill each turn
first_skill_turn.definition: Only the first successfully resolved Skill card in this player turn triggers this effect.

first_passive.label: First Passive each combat
first_passive.definition: Only the first successfully resolved Passive card in this combat triggers this effect. Ultimate is not automatically Passive.

first_exhaust_combat.label: First Exhaust each combat
first_exhaust_combat.definition: Only the first owned card that actually enters Exhaust in this combat triggers this effect.

first_exhaust_turn.label: First Exhaust each turn
first_exhaust_turn.definition: Only the first owned card that actually enters Exhaust in this player turn triggers this effect.

at_least.label: At least
at_least.definition: The value must be equal to or greater than the stated number: ≥.

or_less.label: Or less
or_less.definition: The value must be equal to or smaller than the stated number: ≤.

d6.label: d6
d6.definition: A six-sided die with possible results 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. Roll once for this combat. Fair-die probabilities require the random system to be confirmed.

unspent.label: Unspent Energy
unspent.definition: Energy still left when you choose End Turn. One or more Energy triggers the same fixed Block bonus.

fully_blocked.label: Fully blocked
fully_blocked.definition: Block absorbs all the positive damage of one enemy hit. A zero-damage hit or canceled attack does not qualify.

retaliation.label: Retaliation
retaliation.definition: Damage sent back to the attacker by an artifact. It follows enemy damage reduction and does not count as an Attack card.

cycle.label: Once per turn cycle
cycle.definition: At most once across one player turn and its associated enemy turn.

hp_threshold.label: 50% Max HP or less
hp_threshold.definition: At or below half your Max HP while still alive. This also checks if you start combat below half HP.

effect_discard.label: Discard by a card effect
effect_discard.definition: A card effect moves a card from Hand to Discard. End Turn cleanup, played cards going to Discard and direct Draw Pile discards do not qualify.

highest_discount.label: Highest discount only
highest_discount.definition: Use the largest applicable artifact discount. Owning 5% and 15% gives 15%, not 20%.

cap.label: Artifact contribution cap
cap.definition: A limit on this artifact’s own bonus. Bonuses from other sources can still increase the total.

per_stat.label: Each stat
per_stat.definition: Apply the stated amount separately to every named stat. For example, +3 Strength and +3 Agility each get their own +3.

percent.label: Percent (%)
percent.definition: A number out of 100. To find p% of a value, multiply that value by p and divide by 100.

round_up.label: Round up
round_up.definition: Use the smallest whole number that is not below the calculated price. Example: 86.7 Gold becomes 87 Gold.

range.label: Range
range.definition: In a die result such as 1–2, either 1 or 2 qualifies. The dash marks a range, not subtraction.
